Rated 4.5 from 79 reviews.

If you have a sharpener and can sharpen these yourself it's a much better value. These stay sharp and do not break. They write smooth not gritty. # Golden Bear Orange #2 Pencils (36 Pack) - Made in the USA
Brand: PALOMINO
Category: Incense & Incense Holders > Incense

## Features
Made in the USA out of genuine, California grown, Incense-cedar.; Durable enough for everyday use in the office, at school and at home.; Golden Bear #2 office and school supplies are the perfect writing instrument for students, aspiring authors, journalists, office workers and everyday users.

## Pricing & Reviews
Rated 4.4 from 85 reviews.
Top review: I’ve been sampling pencils this fall and saw references on other Amazon reviews about these. I use pencils a lot in the shop and was not looking specifically for just how they work on paper but how they hold up on paper and wood. I’ve always used Ticonderogas which work ok, but I was finding they often break and when you go to resharpen, they keep breaking. The Golden Bears so far seem better. I need to adjust the dial on my exacto sharpener up one size for them to fit which isn’t that big of a deal. I also sampled the Mitsubishi pencils which may also be up one size. I’ve also sampled a couple models of the Generals, the Cedar Point and the Semi-Hex. The Golden Bears are the cheapest so they have that going for them as my son keeps taking them all to school and tells me he sees lots of other kids using them. I’m not crazy about the blue color and the Golden bear graphic is a bit dull. The blue paint is also a bit thin feeling and the Golden Bears seem to erase the worst out of all the pencils I’ve tried. My son liked the Cedar Points. Not sure exactly why, but he says they erased well. I sort of like the painted finish better. I think the General Semi-Hex is my favorite, although I just used the Mitsubishi a couple times so far. The paint on the Mitsubishi is the nicest, but I don’t think the wood is cedar and it’s s little harder to sharpen and the lead didn’t seem as centered as the generals, but they may be due to it moving a bit in the sharpener. The semi-hex seems to have a slightly harder lead thannthe others and holds up well in the shop.Anyway, I’d buy the Golden Bears again for A cheaper US pencil, but I think the Semi-Hex will be my go to pencil for now.
